name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: A tool that lets an AI agent open a real website and click, fill forms, and read pages the way a person would, even on sites with no official way to connect to them.
buyer: A small agency or consultant building AI automations for clients whose suppliers, competitors, or partners only offer a website, not an API.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce consultant builds an agent that logs into five supplier portals each morning and checks restock dates and prices, something that's impossible without driving the actual site.
A recruiting agency automates posting the same job listing across a dozen job boards that have no public API, using an agent that fills out each site's real form.
A local market-research shop builds a 'watch my competitor's website' service that checks price and stock changes daily for small retailers who can't afford enterprise monitoring tools.

money_ideas.idea: Website automation as a service, billed per task or per site monitored
Subscription competitor price-and-stock monitoring product for small retailers

steal_this: Build a weekend tool that checks ten competitor product pages daily for price changes and emails a report, then sell it as a monthly subscription to local retailers.
